CustomField.label: Definition
CustomField.description: The set's sections and their rules, as JSON: {"sections":[{...,"rules":[...]}]}. Edited through the IDP Configurator LWC or by hand; see IDP_CONFIGURATION.md for the format. Long text areas cost a flat 255 characters against the org's custom metadata allocation regardless of content, which is why sections and rules live here rather than as their own records.
